changed_package_input_definition.description: A changed package/input is a package, page set, runtime artifact, public-HUD bundle, reader-hint package, route package, or per-book baseline target whose path/hash/commit/target differs from the last Agent 4 packaged validator result.
changed_package_input_definition.unchanged_result: If these fields are absent or match the last packaged input, Spark-4 must not rerun validators and must return changed_input_only_blocker.

rules: Commands must be complete executable command lines from repository root.
Commands must refer to existing scripts or existing shell checks.
No command may be inferred from package type.
No browser/public proof command may run without a changed package plus Agent 6 route.

validator_gate.watch_marker_policy: warn_and_route_to_Agent10_Agent6_unless the command explicitly defines watch markers as fatal
validator_gate.runtime_public_proof_policy: blocked unless changed package plus Agent 6 route exists

per_book_baseline_harness.purpose: Baseline validator/prereq evidence for one named book target without candidate-data publication.
per_book_baseline_harness.deuteronomy_cap: Do not rerun unless a changed target/request names Deuteronomy baseline again.

required_for: any package claiming reader-facing answer/gloss/public output

stop_condition.success: Return one Agent 4 validator/prereq/runtime packet for the exact changed input.
stop_condition.missing_input: Return missing_pipeline_blocker naming missing command/input/output/package owner.
stop_condition.unchanged_input: Return changed_input_only_blocker and do not rerun validators.
stop_condition.baseline: Return one per-book baseline artifact or exact command/input blocker.

token_limit_minimum_handoff.target: Reusable changed-package validator/prereq/runtime pipeline contract and per-book baseline harness. Deuteronomy baseline command remains exact but capped unless a changed target/request names it.
token_limit_minimum_handoff.next_changed_input_only_wake_result: Return changed_input_only_blocker unless package owner supplies changed package/input plus exact command list, expected output path/schema, validator/gate, Agent 6 trigger when public/runtime proof is requested, and stop condition.
missing_fields: Agent 6 trigger when public/runtime proof is requested
token_limit_minimum_handoff.handoff_owner: Agent 4 owns validator/prereq pipeline authoring and packets. Spark-4 runs only mechanical validators on changed input.
